description: Authorization for new single-family residential construction structural alterations or additions exceeding 200 sq ft
requirements: Property within municipal boundaries; zoning compliance approval; licensed contractor assigned
documents: Architectural blueprints (3 sets); structural engineer calculations; site survey; deed of ownership; contractor license
application_method: Online citizen portal or in-person at Department of Building Inspection
office: Department of Building Inspection - Hall of Records 2nd Floor

description: Mandatory operating permit for restaurants cafes food trucks and commercial catering within Greenfield
requirements: Health inspection clearance; certified food safety manager on staff; valid fire safety certificate
documents: Food safety manager certificate; commercial kitchen floor plan; grease trap compliance report; county health approval
application_method: Online portal or in-person at Civic Center Room 104
office: Department of Public Health & Commercial Licensing

description: Required for public parades block parties marathons outdoor rallies or festivals occupying public roadways or parks
requirements: Submission at least 30 days prior to event; $1M liability insurance naming City of Greenfield; traffic plan
documents: Certificate of comprehensive liability insurance; detailed route/site map; crowd safety plan; emergency vehicle access layout
application_method: Online via Greenfield Municipal Event Services portal
office: Special Events Bureau - Civic Center Wing B

description: Annual municipal registration for general builders electricians plumbers and HVAC professionals operating in Greenfield
requirements: Passing grade on state trade exam; minimum 3 years verified experience; bond coverage of $25000
documents: State trade license copy; proof of worker compensation insurance; $25000 surety bond verification; tax ID

description: Permit required to raze demolish or remove any existing permanent residential structure or garage
requirements: Utility disconnection sign-offs (water electric gas); pest abatement certification; asbestos inspection report
documents: Asbestos survey report; rodent abatement certificate; utility disconnect verification forms; dust control plan
application_method: In-person at Hall of Records Room 210
office: Department of Building Inspection - Demolition Unit

description: Approval for exterior illuminated signs pole-mounted billboards projecting store awnings or digital displays
requirements: Adherence to Greenfield municipal zoning height and illumination brightness ordinances
documents: Scaled color elevation renderings; electrical schematic diagrams; property owner written consent; footing structural engineering

description: Authorization to alter reconstruct or install a new vehicular curb cut connecting private property to municipal roadway
requirements: Sightline visibility clearance of 150 ft; minimum 25 ft separation from nearest intersection; drainage slope check
documents: Property survey showing proposed driveway apron; stormwater runoff grading plan; right-of-way easement deed
application_method: Online portal or Department of Public Works desk
office: Department of Public Works - Engineering Desk

description: Required to remove any native heritage oak pine or mature hardwood tree with trunk diameter exceeding 12 inches
requirements: Certified arborist report proving tree is dead diseased hazardous or structurally threatening a permitted foundation
documents: Arborist tree condition report; color photographs; replanting proposal or payment into municipal tree canopy fund
fee: $65 application fee (waived if tree poses documented immediate hazard)
application_method: Online submission or Parks Department office

description: Permit permitting quiet low-impact residential businesses (consulting design tutoring software development) in residential zones
requirements: No exterior commercial alteration; no outside employees reporting to home; customer traffic restricted to 2 visits/hour
documents: Floor plan indicating dedicated home office area (max 20% of residence); property owner consent if tenant
application_method: Online citizen portal with instant automated verification

description: Fast-tracked permit for rooftop solar PV panel systems and battery backup storage on single-family homes
requirements: Structural roof adequacy certification; electrical single-line diagram meeting National Electrical Code (NEC)
documents: Rooftop mounting blueprint; electrical schematic; manufacturer panel specifications; licensed electrician sign-off

description: Permit for replacing water heaters furnace installations sewer line repairs or residential repiping
requirements: Work must be executed or supervised by licensed master plumber or licensed mechanical contractor
documents: Scope of work description; equipment BTU and thermal efficiency specifications; schematic layout of piping
application_method: Online contractor portal or walk-in service
office: Department of Building Inspection - Mechanical Unit

description: Annual municipal permit to rent residential dwelling or spare bedroom on vacation rental platforms (Airbnb VRBO)
requirements: Property must be primary residence of applicant; verified working smoke and carbon monoxide detectors; transient occupancy tax registration
documents: Proof of primary residency (voter ID or utility bill); fire safety inspection self-audit checklist; proof of $500000 liability insurance
fee: $180 annual fee + 6% municipal lodging tax compliance
office: Office of Municipal Revenue & Housing Compliance
